items.docs: The single operation endpoint provides information about a specific operation.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID number for this operation.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A number that points to a specific location in a collection of responses and is pulled from the paging_token value of a record.

params.name: order
params.description: A designation of the order in which records should appear. Options include `asc` (ascending) or `desc` (descending). If this argument isn’t set, it defaults to `asc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned. The limit can range from 1 to 200 - an upper limit that is hardcoded in Horizon for performance reasons. If this argument isn’t designated, it defaults to 10.

items.docs: This endpoint lists all Successful operations and can be used in streaming mode. Streaming mode allows you to listen for new operations as they are added to the Stellar ledger. If called in streaming mode, Horizon will start at the earliest known operation unless a cursor is set, in which case it will start from that cursor. By setting the cursor value to now, you can stream operations created since your request time.
